what_it_is.prose:
Chennai-based UAV avionics company (flight controllers/autopilots, Navroc GNSS, sensors, power modules, ground control). Company states products are designed and manufactured in India; component sourcing undisclosed. Drone Expo 2026 exhibitor.

Value-chain position in the Atlas: Develops → Drone flight controller (L3); Develops → GNSS navigation modules (L3).

Evidence discipline: this record separates company claims from independent evidence. Classifications above carry their evidence level; the technology-origin class is 'UNKNOWN'. Exhibiting at Drone Expo 2026 establishes market presence only — not indigenous technology, Indian manufacturing, procurement or deployment.
